answer: One concrete mechanism: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because grove only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, inlet is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any sonnet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
